profileEvidence.summary: Happy and alert, the American Brittany brings an energetic, eager manner to this pointing-dog tradition. American keepers maintain the breed for field work as well as showing. At Frosty Meadows, retired female Bella completed obedience training and won class awards; Cooper, who lived to twelve, was the first dog loaded for family hunting trips.
